judge_leakage.note: prompt is an f-string; hashed from source text

scoring_constants.date_score: exp(-0.1 * |months between predicted and ground truth|)
scoring_constants.frq_scale: 0-10 per dimension; frq_score = mean(alignment, specificity, novelty, feasibility); FRQ pass = score >= 5.0

partition_rule.main_tables: pre if pub_month < cutoff_month else post (cutoff month counts as POST) — make_latex_tables.py, compare_models.py
partition_rule.gap_and_calibration_tables: post if pub_month > cutoff_month (cutoff month counts as PRE) — filter_ids_by_cutoff in make_web_search_cutoff_table.py
partition_rule.note: These two conventions differ by one month and BOTH are used in the published tables. Each table is reproduced under the convention its own generator used, so every Sonnet 5 row is comparable with the six published rows in that same table.

model_under_test.cutoff_source: https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/models/opus-4-8/overview (Reliable knowledge cutoff: Jan 2026; Training data cutoff: Jan 2026)

model_under_test.snapshot_note: dateless ID is a pinned snapshot (4.6 generation onward); response.model echoes claude-opus-4-8
model_under_test.sampling: temperature/top_p/top_k rejected with 400 (verified 2026-09-22); effort=medium; repeated passes bound non-determinism

decoding.thinking: adaptive (always on for this model; not configurable off in the way older models were effectively greedy)

unmatchable_parameters.sonnet5: cannot be sent — HTTP 400 'temperature is deprecated for this model'. The model runs at its default sampling setting, so it is stochastic where the other six were greedy. This is the reason run 1 is executed three times.

unmatchable_parameters.six_published_models: not exposed; no run recorded a reasoning effort setting
unmatchable_parameters.sonnet5: adaptive thinking always on; effort pinned to 'medium' (API default is 'high')

unmatchable_parameters.six_published_models: 250 for Claude Sonnet 4.5 (ANTHROPIC branch), 2048 for the five OpenAI/Azure models
unmatchable_parameters.sonnet5: 384; note Sonnet 5 uses a newer tokenizer, so an identical token cap yields ~26% fewer characters than it did for Claude Sonnet 4.5 (~770 vs ~1036 chars)

judge.api_surface: OpenAI Responses API with the web_search tool (eval.LLMClient._call_responses_api)
two_stage_protocol: stage 1: judge_leakage  — contamination audit, web search forced
stage 2: judge_frq_combined — 4-dimension rubric, 0-10 each, frq_score = unweighted mean of the four
